processes.command:
/bin/bash -eu -c 'echo BASHPID=$$; mkdir -p /tmp/klab-demo; : > /tmp/klab-demo/shell-ready; while [[ ! -f /tmp/klab-demo/input.env ]]; do sleep 0.1; done; source /tmp/klab-demo/input.env; printf "READ_ONE=%s
" "$MESSAGE"; printf "ack:%s
" "$MESSAGE" > /tmp/klab-demo/ack; while [[ ! -f /tmp/klab-demo/final.txt ]]; do sleep 0.1; done; printf "READ_TWO=%s
" "$(cat /tmp/klab-demo/final.txt)"; echo BASH_SESSION_DONE'
